# CodeLifeAI — Complete Technical & Organizational Profile

## Executive Summary
CodeLifeAI (official brand: CodeLifeAI, URL: https://codelifeai.com) is a high-velocity software engineering studio and digital product development company. Founded by senior engineers Muhammad Ahmed (CEO) and Anas Waheed (CTO), the firm delivers production-grade software across four core pillars:
1. Modern Full-Stack Web Development
2. High-Performance Cross-Platform Mobile Applications
3. Custom Artificial Intelligence (AI) Agents & LLM Integration
4. Enterprise Cloud Architecture & DevOps Automation

## Leadership & Founders
- **Muhammad Ahmed** — Co-Founder & Chief Executive Officer (CEO). Oversees product vision, software architecture, technical delivery, and client partnerships.
- **Anas Waheed** — Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer (CTO). Leads core engineering, distributed systems design, AI model integration, and cloud infrastructure.

## Technical Capabilities & Technology Stack
- **Frontend:** React.js, Next.js 15 (App Router, Server Components), TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion, Three.js (WebGL 3D graphics), HTML5, Vanilla CSS.
- **Mobile Development:** Flutter, Dart, React Native, iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin), SQLite, Firebase, WebRTC.
- **Backend & APIs:** Node.js, Express, Python (FastAPI, Flask), Go (Golang), REST APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets, gRPC.
- **Database & Caching:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, LibSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Supabase, Pinecone, ChromaDB (Vector Databases).
- **AI & Machine Learning:** OpenAI GPT-4o / O1, Google Gemini 2.0, Anthropic Claude 3.5, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Fine-Tuning, Hugging Face, Tesseract OCR.
- **Cloud & DevOps:** Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions, Linux administration, Prometheus, Grafana.

## Portfolio Projects & Shipped Products
1. **FinTrack — Real-Time Banking & Wealth Dashboard**
   - Domain: Fintech & Banking
   - Technologies: React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, TailwindCSS
   - Key Features: Sub-second multi-currency portfolio valuation, automated transaction classification, real-time banking analytics.
   - Outcome Metric: 10,000+ active users.
   - Live URL: https://fintrack.codelifeai.com

2. **ShopEase — High-Conversion E-Commerce Platform**
   - Domain: E-Commerce & Retail
   - Technologies: Next.js 15, Stripe Connect, MongoDB, Redis
   - Key Features: Sub-50ms product catalog search, personalized recommendations, multi-currency checkout, automated inventory sync.
   - Outcome Metric: $2M+ in transactions processed.
   - Live URL: https://shopease.codelifeai.com

3. **MedSync — Telehealth & Patient Records Mobile App**
   - Domain: Healthcare & Telemedicine
   - Technologies: Flutter, Firebase, WebRTC, Dart
   - Key Features: HIPAA-compliant HD video consultations, digital prescription management, real-time vitals monitoring.
   - Outcome Metric: 4.9★ rating on the App Store.
   - Live URL: https://medsync.app

4. **LogiFlow — Intelligent Supply Chain SaaS**
   - Domain: Logistics & Supply Chain
   - Technologies: React, Python FastAPI, AWS ECS, PostgreSQL, Docker
   - Key Features: 2M+ telemetry events/day, automated dynamic GPS route optimization, predictive warehouse inventory replenishment.
   - Outcome Metric: 35% reduction in operational logistics costs.
   - Live URL: https://logiflow.io

5. **ZYRA AI — Multimodal Autonomous Work Assistant**
   - Domain: Artificial Intelligence & Workflow Automation
   - Technologies: Gemini 2.0, LangChain, Next.js, Python, Vector DB
   - Key Features: Autonomous research agents, automated code generation & refactoring, document intelligence, interactive charts.
   - Outcome Metric: 50,000+ early adopters.
   - Live URL: https://zyra-ai.com

6. **SocialPulse — AI Sentiment & Viral Growth Engine**
   - Domain: Marketing Technology & Social Analytics
   - Technologies: Python, OpenAI, React, FastAPI, Redis
   - Key Features: Real-time sentiment tracking across Twitter/LinkedIn/Instagram, competitor intelligence, automated content suggestions.
   - Outcome Metric: 500+ agency clients.
   - Live URL: https://socialpulse.io

7. **ScreenSnap — AI Screen Capture & Annotation Suite**
   - Domain: Productivity & Developer Tools
   - Technologies: Electron, React, WebRTC, Tesseract OCR, Cloudflare
   - Key Features: One-click HD screen recording, automated OCR text extraction from screenshots, cloud link generation.
   - Outcome Metric: 120,000+ downloads.
   - Live URL: https://screensnap.app

8. **EduPath — Interactive Video LMS & Skill Academy**
   - Domain: EdTech & Online Learning
   - Technologies: Next.js, HLS Video, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Stripe
   - Key Features: Adaptive bitrate video streaming, in-browser code editor for exercises, automated course completion certification.
   - Outcome Metric: 20,000+ enrolled students.
   - Live URL: https://edupath.academy

9. **CloudGuard — Zero-Trust DevOps & Cluster Monitor**
   - Domain: Cloud Infrastructure & Security
   - Technologies: Go, Kubernetes, Prometheus, React, Docker
   - Key Features: Real-time Kubernetes pod visualization, anomaly detection, automated container vulnerability alerts.
   - Outcome Metric: 99.999% production cluster reliability.
   - Live URL: https://cloudguard.dev

10. **Alarmify — AI Sleep Partner & Smart Wake System**
    - Domain: Health & Lifestyle Mobile Apps
    - Technologies: Flutter, TensorFlow Lite, Audio DSP, SQLite, iOS
    - Key Features: On-device sleep cycle analysis using acoustic sensors, gentle optimal-phase alarm awakening.
    - Outcome Metric: 25,000+ daily active users.
    - Live URL: https://alarmify.app
